summary: Keep the pool's SMB share identity through promotion and member adoption, claim an SMB repository only after its marker matches and inside new-mount rollback, mount SMB backup repositories nosuid,nodev,noexec, and make the NFS/SMB backend hide and later finish interrupted deletions, clear aborted staging and crash leftovers, and report aborted points as absent. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Operators now see prune name an unexpected point entry, file-manager litter is removed by Core, and NFS/SMB3 catalog rebuild no longer waits for an interrupted prune.

api.reason: The peer SMB request already carries the expected identity; Core now passes it into its own preparation. No route, payload, permission or result change between Controller and Core.

roadmap.reason: Corrects the current destination safety and recovery gate.

state.reason: No new durable record. The replicated repository row on the pool master keeps its SMB share marker identity through promotion; filesystem delete intents in the repository are now removed once the master's catalog entry is gone. A fresh Controller adopts the master's authenticated inventory as before.

verification.method: New vmhost and agent tests failed red through go test -overlay with the prior ordering or behaviour (owner claimed on a share with another marker; new SMB unit left after a failed publication probe; stale probe directory kept; promotion prepared without the pool marker; half-deleted point readable and scanned; interrupted deletion never finished; .DS_Store blocked delete; aborted point reported as not a directory; abort refused its own staging) and pass after the fix. Focused vmhost backup/storage tests and agent backup/repository tests passed apart from failures in other batches' in-progress files.
verification.limits: Unit fixtures only; no real CIFS/NFS mount, promotion lab or NAS. Existing lab SMB backup units written without nosuid,nodev,noexec must be detached before re-preparation. NFS backup mounts gained the same options later (BUG-0724, nfs-backup-mount-options). Forge CI remains open.
